visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a black cropped hoodie and light blue jeans, holds a bent and damaged silver metal motorcycle lever directly toward the camera. She has an angry and frustrated facial expression, speaking with intense mouth movements. The setting is an outdoor paved parking area with green trees and a wall in the background under overcast daylight. (2) A quick shot transitions to the woman riding a green and black Honda motorcycle, now wearing a full-face helmet with colorful graphics. (3) A man in an olive-green hooded jacket walks across a stone-paved plaza and performatively falls onto the ground in front of the camera; cartoonish yellow star graphics appear around his head to signify impact. (4) The woman in the black hoodie is seen falling sideways onto the ground while wearing her colorful helmet; a black bird graphic with dots appears next to her to highlight the comedic nature of the fall. (5) The woman stands next to the green motorcycle, inspecting the handlebars with a focused look. (6) The camera zooms in on the bent brake lever on the handlebar, followed by another shot of the woman holding the damaged part while looking into the lens with fire graphics appearing around her to show anger. (7) A man in the olive jacket kneels and presents two brand-new motorcycle levers in pink and silver colors, smiling warmly. (8) A sequence of professionally shot product visuals shows the 'REYS' brake levers in various colors (black, gold, blue, red, pink) and 3D renders detailing their internal spring and knob mechanism. (9) The woman rides the motorcycle through a park setting, turning her head and giving a thumbs-up to the camera. (10) Close-up shots show hands installing the new lever and rotating a small black adjustment knob on the top of the lever assembly to demonstrate the multi-stage settings. (11) The woman continues riding the green motorcycle on a paved road, with red arrows and text overlays pointing to the newly installed silver lever. (12) The video ends with a logo graphic featuring two crossed levers against a yellow burst background.
